Beyond the gates of SpinWinter Casino lies a northern kingdom of gaming entertainment, complete with its own tournaments, treasury of rewards and system of VIP ranks. We bring together over 10,000 games, sports betting, tournaments and jackpots with a prize pool of up to €1,000,000. At the heart of our kingdom is the Premium Shop, where accumulated Chips can be exchanged for digital and physical rewards.

At SpinWinter, every player chooses their own path, from discovering classic slots to taking part in tournaments. Four welcome packages, five-day challenges and a multi-tier VIP Club complement our gaming collection. Explore our entertainment options and discover the features of our northern kingdom at your own pace.

SpinWinter Welcome Bonuses

To begin your story at SpinWinter Casino, we have created four welcome packages. Each comes with its own reward value, number of qualifying deposits and conditions of use.

The Casino Welcome Pack includes 550% up to €12,100, 550 Free Spins on Gold Rush - Johnny Cash and 300,000 Chips. The rewards are spread across your first five deposits.

The VIP Welcome Pack provides a combined 800% across your first four deposits, along with an additional 300,000 Chips. Higher minimum deposit requirements apply to this package.

The Crypto Welcome Pack includes 620% up to 14,500 USDT and 620 Free Spins on Bonanza Trillion. The offer covers your first five qualifying deposits.

The Sport Welcome Pack includes 150% in FreeBets for selected football competitions. Specific odds requirements and bet slip conditions apply to these sports rewards.

Once you have completed your welcome package at SpinWinter, Weekly Reloads become available. The programme includes eight weekly offers with bonuses of up to 100% and individual rewards worth up to €700. Activation, wagering and reward conditions are available alongside our bonuses and regular promotions.

Gaming Lobby From Classic Slots to Live Tables

More than 100 game developers contribute to the diverse gaming collection at SpinWinter Casino. We have organised their titles into dedicated categories, including Top, New, Trending Games and Bonus Wager, alongside a game search and provider filters. Discover familiar gaming formats and new mechanics with their own distinctive features.

Slots and Table Games

Our Slots category combines classic machines with fixed paylines and modern video slots featuring cascading wins, multipliers and themed bonus rounds. Game settings take you through ancient civilisations, fantasy worlds and legendary eras. SpinWinter also features Megaways slots, where the number of possible winning combinations changes with each spin.

Among our popular titles, Wanted Dead or a Wild by Hacksaw Gaming features special symbols and multipliers during its bonus rounds. Lion Gems 3 Pots uses the Hold and Win mechanic, built around collecting prize symbols. Elephant's Gold complements the selection with its own Bonus Combo feature.

We regularly update our New category with traditional reel-based slots and alternative gaming formats. Bingo Empire, for example, incorporates bingo mechanics, while Mines Football combines a football theme with the selection of individual gaming positions.

For fans of traditional table games, we offer digital versions of roulette, blackjack and poker. These games use random number generators to determine their outcomes, with rounds taking place without a live dealer.

Live Casino and Game Shows

Our Live Casino is like a separate hall within our kingdom, where real dealers host games at the tables. We have brought together over 300 games streamed from dedicated gaming studios. SpinWinter Casino features traditional, fast-paced and specialised live games with different rules and betting limits.

The Roulette category includes classic tables, automated wheels and variations with additional multipliers. Venice Roulette features a live studio broadcast, while Auto Roulette uses an automated wheel. Gravity Roulette adds its own bonus mechanics to the traditional rules.

Our Blackjack category includes tables with different round speeds and betting limits. Speed Blackjack offers a faster-paced format, while Monaco Blackjack VIP belongs to our selection of dedicated VIP tables.

For alternative entertainment, SpinWinter features a dedicated Game Shows category. Adventures Beyond Wonderland Live combines a themed prize wheel with additional rounds, while Wheel of Fortune uses wheel segments with different outcomes. Our live collection also includes baccarat, Sic Bo and Dragon Tiger.

Bonus Wager Games

We have created a dedicated Bonus Wager collection featuring games that can contribute towards bonus wagering requirements. The selection includes Snoop Dogg Dollars by BGaming, while The Great Icescape features cascading wins. Each game's wagering contribution depends on the conditions of the active promotion.

Tournament Arena and Major Jackpots

The SpinWinter Casino tournament arena brings together network tournaments, regular races and promotions featuring randomly awarded cash prizes. Each event has its own rules, prize pool and selection of participating slots. Competition formats differ in how winners are determined and rewards are distributed.

  • Lucky Boom - a total prize pool of €600,000, divided into stages worth €30,000 each. Cash prizes may be awarded randomly during spins that meet the promotion's requirements.
  • Big Sunday Blast - a weekly Sunday event featuring a €25,000 prize pool and a dedicated collection of participating slots.
  • VIP Weekly - regular tournament competitions with their own prize pool and participation requirements.
  • Multi Race - tournament races with a dedicated scoring system.

We have created dedicated game collections for Lucky Boom and Big Sunday Blast. These promotions feature eligible slots from Playson and Booongo. Participation requirements and prize distribution are determined by the rules of each competition.

Jackpots form a separate treasury within SpinWinter. We feature fixed jackpots with predetermined prize amounts and progressive jackpots that grow through qualifying bets. Once a progressive jackpot is won, the prize pool resets and begins accumulating again.

Premium Shop and the Treasury of Rewards

The Premium Shop at SpinWinter Casino is our treasury of digital and physical prizes, with its own reward currency known as Chips. These are earned through deposits and eligible slot bets. Your Chips are stored separately from your main cash balance.

Every €1 deposited earns 50 Chips. Eligible slot bets award 20 Chips for every €0.20 wagered. Accumulated Chips can be exchanged for items from the available shop collection.

The SpinWinter treasury includes several reward categories:

  • Free Spins - packages of free spins for slot games.
  • Real Money and Bonus Money - cash and bonus funds subject to their respective conditions.
  • Mystery Cases - Silver, Gold and Premium Cases containing hidden rewards.
  • Gift Cards - vouchers for Amazon, Steam, Uber, Apple, Decathlon, Starbucks and other brands.
  • Premium Items - physical rewards, including the Land Rover Defender.

Every reward has its own price in Chips and conditions for redemption. We update our shop collection and introduce special offers. You can view your accumulated Chips and available rewards when you log in to your account.

The Five-Day WinStreak Quest

WinStreak is a separate challenge within the kingdom of SpinWinter Casino, built around a series of gaming tasks. The quest runs over five days, with specific rules governing each stage. A final reward is available upon completion of all required tasks in accordance with the promotion's conditions.

Unlike SpinWinter tournaments, this feature focuses on your individual progress through the challenge. A dedicated section of your account displays your current progress, available tasks and the value of the final reward.

Wheel of Gods Zeus and Hades

Ancient legends come to life in Wheel of Gods, a dedicated SpinWinter Casino mini-game featuring two prize wheels. Zeus and Hades have their own access requirements. Once the initial deposit requirement has been met, one free spin on the Zeus Wheel becomes available each day, while an additional spin on the Hades Wheel requires payment.

Each wheel contains eight segments, with outcomes determined randomly. Possible rewards include up to €435 in bonus funds and packages ranging from 5 to 100 Free Spins. Unused free wheel spins do not accumulate, and awarded prizes are subject to their own wagering and conversion requirements.

SpinWinter Casino VIP Club From Bronze to Obsidian

Our northern kingdom has its own hierarchy of VIP ranks. The programme consists of 17 levels across five categories - Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Obsidian. Progress is measured through Gems earned from deposits and Stars awarded for eligible gaming activity. Your achieved status is not downgraded solely because of inactivity.

Daily cashback at SpinWinter can reach 40%, while rakeback can reach 60%. Cashback is calculated from eligible gaming losses, whereas rakeback depends on gaming turnover and the house edge. The maximum amount returned under the programme's conditions is €10,000.

Level-Up Rewards include up to €5,000 and 200 Free Spins. At eligible levels, members can access a personal VIP manager, individual bonus offers, exclusive tournaments and higher withdrawal limits. Each VIP rank has its own set of privileges, which can be viewed in your account.

Sports Betting and Esports

Beyond the gaming halls of SpinWinter Casino, our sportsbook covers international championships, domestic leagues and individual sporting competitions. We focus on football, cricket and tennis, alongside basketball, ice hockey, boxing and other disciplines.

Our football coverage includes the English Premier League and domestic championships in Spain, Italy, Germany and France. European club competitions and international fixtures involving national teams are also available. Depending on the event, betting markets include match results, totals, handicaps and other outcomes.

SpinWinter features two main betting formats - Pre-Match and Live Betting. Pre-match markets cover upcoming fixtures, while live betting displays available markets and changing odds as events unfold. Accumulator bets can combine multiple events, and dedicated categories cover outright betting markets.

We have created a separate esports section featuring Counter-Strike 2, Valorant and Dota 2 competitions. Virtual eFootball matches are also available in our sportsbook. The gaming lobby and sports betting section share a single account and balance.

Depositing Funds

The SpinWinter Casino cashier supports debit cards, mobile payment services and cryptocurrency transactions. We operate a multi-currency account system that includes EUR and GBP. Available payment options depend on your country of residence, account currency and the conditions of the respective payment service.

The standard minimum deposit in euros is €20. Separate minimum deposit requirements may apply to bonus offers. We do not charge our own deposit processing fees, although banks and third-party payment services may apply additional charges.

The SpinWinter cryptocurrency cashier supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Solana, Bitcoin Cash, Dogecoin and Tron. Stablecoin transactions are also available through USDT on the TRC-20 and ERC-20 networks, alongside USDC. When transferring funds, the blockchain network must match the payment address network specified in the cashier.

Withdrawals and Payout Limits

Withdrawal requests at SpinWinter Casino are submitted through your account cashier. The minimum withdrawal in euros is €50, while maximum limits depend on your selected payment method. Individual card withdrawals can reach €3,000, while cryptocurrency transactions can reach €10,000.

Before requesting a withdrawal, deposited funds must be wagered once (x1) in accordance with our financial rules. If active bonus funds remain in your account, separate wagering requirements apply. Requesting a withdrawal before completing the bonus conditions may result in the cancellation of the reward and associated winnings.

We process withdrawal requests within three working days in accordance with our general terms and conditions. Subsequent settlement follows the processing procedures of the relevant payment service. You can view the status of your financial transactions in your account history.

At SpinWinter, deposits and withdrawals must be made using payment details belonging to the account holder. Before completing a financial transaction, we may request proof of ownership of the relevant bank account, card or cryptocurrency wallet.

Financial Security and Verification

To protect personal information at SpinWinter Casino, we use SSL encryption and financial transaction monitoring procedures. Identity verification is carried out before withdrawals, when cumulative deposits reach €2,000 or when suspicious activity is detected.

Our Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures may require a passport, national identity card or driving licence. Where necessary, we may request a selfie with your identification document and proof of residential address. Proof of address must have been issued within the previous three months.

For deposits exceeding €5,000, SpinWinter may require additional Source of Funds verification. These procedures help us establish ownership of payment methods, prevent unauthorised transactions and maintain compliance with our financial rules.

SpinWinter Casino Mobile Experience

We have made our gaming kingdom accessible from smartphones as well as computers. Our website is adapted for Android and iOS devices and runs directly through a web browser. There is no need to download APK files or install a separate application.

Our mobile collection includes over 9,800 games, covering video slots, table games and live dealer broadcasts. The gaming interface adapts to your device's screen size. Individual game availability depends on the technical capabilities of your smartphone and browser.

The SpinWinter mobile website also provides access to sports betting, the Premium Shop, tournaments and the cashier. Active rewards, transaction history and account settings are available without switching to the desktop website.

We use a single account across computers and smartphones. Your main balance, accumulated Chips, WinStreak progress and current VIP status are retained when switching devices. You do not need to create an additional account for mobile access.

24/7 Customer Support

Our SpinWinter Casino customer support team is available around the clock through Live Chat. We assist with account access, document verification, financial transactions and bonus conditions.

Our chat service also provides information about tournament rules, Premium Shop mechanics and individual gaming features. When investigating financial enquiries, we may request additional information about the relevant transaction.

Responsible Gambling

At SpinWinter, we treat gambling exclusively as a form of entertainment for adults aged 18 and over. Gambling outcomes are uncertain, and bonuses, cashback and other rewards do not guarantee profits or the recovery of money spent.

We provide options for setting financial limits and requesting voluntary self-exclusion. Account access restrictions can be arranged through our customer support team. During self-exclusion, gambling activity, deposits and participation in promotions are blocked. Stay within your personal budget and never use gambling as a way to recover financial losses.

The SpinWinter Casino Bonus treasury accompanies players throughout their journey across our northern kingdom, from their first deposit to the highest VIP rank, Obsidian. We have brought together welcome packages, weekly deposit bonuses, tournaments, prize wheels and our own rewards shop. Each offer comes with specific conditions for activation, use and prize redemption.

At SpinWinter, you can choose the rewards that suit your gaming preferences. Separate welcome offers are available for slots, cryptocurrency deposits and sports betting, while our loyalty programme complements them with personal privileges. Explore the terms of available promotions before activating them.

Welcome Bonuses for New Players

To begin your journey at SpinWinter Casino, we have created four Welcome Packs. Bonus rewards are spread across your initial deposits, with each reward depending on the selected offer and deposit amount. Our welcome packages differ not only in their bonus percentages but also in the types of bonus funds and additional rewards available.

Casino Welcome Pack

Our standard welcome package includes 550% up to €12,100, 550 Free Spins and 300,000 Chips for the Premium Shop. We have distributed these rewards across your first five deposits, with a separate bonus percentage and maximum amount for each deposit.

The first deposit comes with 110% up to €1,000 and 110 FS, the second — 120% up to €1,200 and 120 FS, and the third — 130% up to €1,400 and 130 FS. The fourth deposit includes 100% up to €4,000 and 100 FS, while the fifth includes 90% up to €4,500 and 90 FS. The minimum qualifying deposit in euros is €30.

Free Spins on Gold Rush - Johnny Cash are credited automatically after each qualifying deposit. Each free spin has a value of €0.20, and the maximum winnings from Free Spins are capped at €1,000.

VIP Welcome Pack

The VIP Welcome Pack at SpinWinter provides a combined 800% across your first four deposits, alongside an additional 300,000 Chips. The first stage includes a 250% bonus, the second — 100%, the third — 150%, and the fourth — 300%. The minimum qualifying deposit for each stage in euros is €250.

Unlike the standard Casino Welcome Pack, this offer does not include Free Spins. Receiving the VIP Welcome Pack does not automatically grant you a higher VIP rank, as our loyalty programme operates through a separate progression system.

Crypto Welcome Pack

For cryptocurrency deposits, SpinWinter Casino features a dedicated package of 620% up to 14,500 USDT and 620 FS. The rewards are spread across your first five deposits, with a minimum qualifying deposit of 30 USDT. Our cryptocurrency cashier supports BTC, ETH, USDT, LTC, DOGE and TRX.

Void bets and bets placed using real money do not count unless otherwise specified in the offer's terms.

Sport Welcome Pack

The SpinWinter Sport Welcome Pack includes a combined 150% in FreeBets. The offer consists of three 50% stages and is available exclusively within our sportsbook. Specific conditions apply to eligible sporting events, betting markets and bet slip requirements.

  • Only accumulator bets consisting of two or three events are eligible.
  • Event odds must fall within the specified range of 8.00 to 20.00.
  • Only pre-match betting markets are permitted, with live betting excluded.
  • Eligible competitions include leading European football leagues, UEFA club competitions and selected international fixtures involving national teams.
  • FreeBets remain valid for seven days after being credited.

When winnings are calculated, the original FreeBet stake is not returned. Net winnings are credited to your real-money balance without additional wagering requirements. Single bets, system bets, friendly matches and youth competitions are excluded from this offer.

SpinWinter Casino Bonus Terms and Conditions

Each deposit bonus comes with specific conditions governing the use of bonus funds. The maximum stake with an active Casino, VIP or Crypto Welcome Pack bonus is €5. Bonus funds and Free Spins winnings are subject to a x40 wagering requirement, which must be completed within seven days.

The maximum withdrawal from bonus winnings is limited to five times the original bonus amount. Free Spins winnings are subject to a separate maximum withdrawal multiplier of x2. These restrictions determine the amount available for withdrawal once the applicable wagering requirements have been completed.

Requesting a withdrawal before fulfilling the conditions of an active promotion results in the forfeiture of the bonus and associated winnings. The same rules apply when voluntarily cancelling a reward through your account or our customer support team. Read the full terms of your selected offer before activation.

Weekly Reloads and Repeat Deposit Bonuses

Once you have completed your welcome package at SpinWinter Casino, our Weekly Reloads become available. We have created deposit bonus offers for every day of the week, including an additional exclusive Friday promotion. Tournament Arena and Gaming Quests

The SpinWinter Casino tournament arena brings together several independent competition formats. We host regular races, themed events featuring randomly awarded cash prizes and jackpot games. Each promotion has its own participation requirements and prize distribution rules.

Lucky Boom

Lucky Boom features a total prize pool of €600,000, divided into individual stages worth €30,000 each. Participation requires at least 100 spins with a minimum stake of €0.50 on eligible slots. Each spin meeting these requirements may trigger a random cash prize.

The promotion allows individual participants to receive multiple prizes while rewards remain available. Our dedicated game collection includes Sun of Egypt 3, inspired by ancient Egypt, and 3 Coin Volcanoes, which features a prize symbol collection mechanic. Unclaimed prizes expire 90 days after being awarded.

Big Sunday Blast

Big Sunday Blast is our weekly Sunday event featuring a €25,000 prize pool. Only real-money bets placed on eligible games count towards participation. The minimum requirements are 100 spins with a stake of at least €0.50.

Our themed collection includes Hold and Win slots such as Tiger's Gold and Hit the Gold! Rewards are credited automatically or following the conclusion of the tournament, in accordance with the event's rules.

VIP Weekly and Multi Race

Our regular VIP Weekly and Multi Race tournaments complement larger network promotions with separate prize pools. Each competition has its own participation requirements and scoring system. Current progress, tournament results and available reward amounts are displayed in the relevant section of our casino.

Fixed and Progressive Jackpots

One of the largest treasuries within the SpinWinter Casino Bonus system is our jackpot prize pool of up to €1,000,000. We feature two main jackpot formats, each with a different method of determining the prize amount.

Fixed jackpots have predetermined prize values. Progressive jackpots grow through bets that meet the rules of the individual game, with the prize pool resetting and accumulating again once the jackpot is won. Some slots feature multiple jackpot types with separate activation conditions.

The Five-Day WinStreak Quest

WinStreak is a personal challenge within our northern kingdom, built around a series of gaming tasks. The quest runs over five days, with a final reward available upon completion of all required stages in accordance with the promotion's conditions.

Unlike tournaments, WinStreak focuses on individual progress. Available tasks, completed stages and the value of the final reward can be viewed in the dedicated section of your account.

Wheel of Gods and Daily Rewards

Ancient legends come to life in Wheel of Gods, where we have brought together two prize wheels with different access requirements. The Zeus Wheel provides one free spin per day once the initial deposit requirement has been met. The Hades Wheel becomes available for a paid spin after the free attempt has been used.

Each wheel contains eight segments. Possible rewards include bonus funds ranging from €1 to €435 and packages of 5 to 100 FS. Outcomes are determined randomly, unused free attempts do not carry over, and awarded prizes are subject to individual wagering requirements and a maximum conversion multiplier of x5.

Loyalty Programme and the Premium Shop Treasury

We have created the Premium Shop as an independent rewards system that uses its own currency, known as Chips, instead of regular money. Chips are credited automatically through deposits and eligible slot bets. Every €1 deposited earns 50 Chips, while an eligible €0.20 slot bet earns 20 Chips.

The SpinWinter treasury includes several categories of rewards:

  • Free Spins — complimentary spins on eligible slot games.
  • Real Money and Bonus Money — cash and bonus funds subject to separate conditions of use.
  • Mystery Cases — Silver, Gold and Premium Cases containing hidden rewards.
  • Gift Cards — vouchers for Steam, Amazon, Apple, Nike Store and other brands.
  • Premium Items — physical rewards, including the Land Rover Defender.

The value of each item is determined by the number of Chips required for redemption. Accumulated Chips are used separately from your real-money balance and VIP progression. To view available rewards and your personal shop balance, simply log in to your account.

VIP Programme and Privileges From Bronze to Obsidian

Our VIP Club hierarchy consists of 17 levels across five categories. Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum each contain four levels, while Obsidian represents the highest rank within the programme. Every category features its own cashback rates, rakeback rates and additional privileges.

We use Gems and Stars to measure progress through our VIP ranks. Every €10 deposited earns one Gem, while €1 of eligible gaming turnover earns 10 Stars. Qualifying sports bets earn double Stars.

Cashback and Rakeback

The Bronze category features cashback of up to 6% and rakeback of up to 5%. Silver increases these maximum rates to 10% and 19% respectively, while Gold features up to 14% and 30%. Platinum provides up to 25% cashback and 45% rakeback, while Obsidian features the programme's highest rates of 40% and 60% respectively.

Cashback is calculated from eligible gaming losses, while rakeback is based on gaming turnover and the house edge. The maximum amount returned under the programme's conditions is €10,000. Available rewards can be collected once per day through the VIP Program section.

Level-Up Rewards and Personal Privileges

We have introduced dedicated Level-Up Rewards for reaching new VIP levels, with rewards of up to €5,000 and 200 FS. Depending on their rank, members may receive a personal VIP manager, individual bonus offers, access to exclusive tournaments and higher withdrawal limits.

Your achieved VIP status is not downgraded solely because of inactivity. Personal privileges, accumulated Gems and Stars, and available rewards are displayed in your profile. Discover the other features of our northern kingdom on the SpinWinter Casino homepage.

Responsible Use of Bonuses

We consider SpinWinter Casino Bonus an additional element of gambling entertainment for adults aged 18 and over. Bonus funds, tournament prizes and loyalty rewards do not guarantee profits or eliminate the risk of financial losses. Stay within your personal budget and consider the conditions attached to each promotion. Never increase your spending simply to reach a higher VIP rank, fulfil wagering requirements or complete a gaming quest.
